items.description: Demonstrated fabricated computational or experimental evidence presented as genuine invalidates the submission.
Demonstrated unauthorized use of hidden evaluator answers invalidates the submission. Ordinary calculation failure, incomplete coverage or disagreement affects only the associated scientific leaves.

scope_note: Only fabrication or unauthorized hidden-answer use can invalidate the entire submission. Ordinary scientific failure applies to the affected final propositions. PR-disclosed source information is authorized but is not generated evidence.
